visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three women are positioned inside a well-lit clothing retail store. One woman stands in the center background wearing a blue crop top and brown pants, while the other two sit on a low display platform in the foreground. They smile at the camera as the standing woman counts down using her fingers. (2) The scene shifts slightly but remains in the store as the three women begin a synchronized rhythmic hand-slapping routine on their thighs and then together. The background shows racks of colorful apparel and a 'STAYREAL' brand logo. (3) The setting transitions to a brightly lit area with a large, vibrant orange carrot-like mascot with a green sprout on top. The women are crouched or standing around the mascot, continuing their highly synchronized hand-clapping and thigh-slapping movements with focused expressions. (4) The women are now seated at a dark wooden table in a dimly lit indoor room, possibly a cafe or studio. They perform the same rhythmic slapping pattern directly on the table surface, their movements perfectly in time with one another. (5) The final phase takes place outdoors on an urban street at dusk. The women are gathered around a black ornate streetlamp. They perform the rhythmic routine one last time, striking the lamp post. The background features city street lights and retail signs like 'AIR SPACE'.

(3) The rhythmic beat continues consistently. The texture of the percussion shifts slightly to a hollow thudding sound as if hitting a larger, hollow object.
